title: Chapter 1878: Treasure Urn (II)
content:
Chapter 1878: Treasure Urn (II)

Seeing that Li Ximing still refused to release his divine ability even now, Shehu wept, "You must want my life and possessions, esteemed cultivator. I will gladly offer them up. I hope only that this fragment of my true spirit can escape and find some demonic body to inhabit. Once my divine abilities are gone, my spirituality will naturally separate from my true spirit. You can then take it to secure my loyalty.

"After all these years of cultivation, my Dao conduct is not shallow. I doubt there is a Foundation Establishment Realm cultivator I could not defeat... I could also guide your juniors, master..."

Li Ximing smiled. "You make it sound appealing, but how could changing bodies be so simple? Still, I did not come here because I had to kill you."

Shehu tried to speak again, but Li Ximing raised his sleeve and invoked his divine ability. Casting its light upon the demon from a distance, he commanded, "Restrain arms and halt all attacks! Let there be no sneak attacks!"

[Radiance Under Heaven].

Hazy golden light suddenly shone down, pinning the demon in place. Shehu, however, had no intention of submitting. His expression turned vicious, and he twisted, trying to break free!

But in that brief moment, an urn had already appeared in Li Ximing's hand.

It was the [Heavenly Nurturing Urn].

[Gathering and Storing]!

A cloud of hazy radiance poured from the urn's mouth and rapidly expanded. Like a great whale drawing in water, it seized the demon on the ground. Shehu had reached the end of his rope, and was utterly exhausted. Restrained by the Fate Divine Ability as well, he could offer no resistance and fell into the urn alone.

Clatter.

The bronze basin's brilliant radiance vanished at once, and the jewel's green light also dimmed. Only his empty robes drifted down, wrapped around a storage pouch, and floated in the heavenly light.

But as the mystic of [Grand Sacrifice] activated, Li Ximing had no time even to collect the spirit artifact. The mana of his divine ability was rapidly consumed, and the urn grew heavy in his hand, as though it held a small mountain. Its captive continued struggling, producing muffled thuds. For a moment, Li Ximing nearly lost his grip.

He hurriedly sat cross-legged and circulated his divine ability, finally steadying the spirit treasure. The light overhead quickly faded, and Li Zhouwei put away the spirit artifact and descended through the air. Seeing Li Ximing drenched in sweat, he reached out to support the urn.

After fifteen minutes, the spirit treasure had absorbed a vast amount of mana from both their divine abilities. It finally grew still, sealing the great demon completely inside, though it remained as heavy as a mountain.

We did it! A green talisman!

The first green talisman our family will refine for ourselves!

Li Ximing breathed a sigh of relief, his delight plain to see. "What a treasure!"

He looked down into the urn. Its interior was dim and gloomy. The densely packed grains of rice were gone, replaced by layer upon layer of black clouds, dark and foreboding.

It was Li Ximing's first time seeing an art capable of containing a person, and the one sealed inside was a divine ability cultivator. He was filled with amazement. Meanwhile, Li Zhouwei brought out the bronze basin.

The basin was rather thin, and its light had dimmed. Its patterns were now indistinct, with only a few colors resembling green birds circling over it. Yet with the Li Family's years of experience fighting Buddhist cultivators, the two quickly spotted traces of Buddhist cultivation within it.

"That Maha must have obtained the spirit artifact and altered it in preparation for refining it. Then this demon got hold of it, but he knew nothing of artifact refinement and left it untouched all these years."

The other [Orthodox Wood] spirit embryo was made of fine material, but Shehu lacked the inheritance and skills of human cultivators, so its refinement was somewhat crude.

The robes were entirely mundane, but the storage pouch was heavy. Li Ximing was quite pleased. "Since he escaped from a Maha, he must have taken quite a few spirit items amid the upheaval. He also kept a spirit root hidden away. After so many years of blossoms and harvests, he must have accumulated a considerable fortune. I doubt he is any poorer than the cultivators on the mainland."

Li Zhouwei smiled and looked down at [Lesser Broadsky Mountain]. The temple was deserted, with no one in sight. Its inhabitants had presumably either hidden or fled.

The formation here was only at the Foundation Establishment Realm. With a flick of his finger, he blasted it apart, and the two descended. The temple was now dim, its corridors extending deep into the complex. Below them knelt a crowd of monks and nuns with little or no cultivation who had not dared to flee. All wore shackles and trembled with fear.

Li Zhouwei glanced at them and realized that these supposed monks and nuns all actually followed the Purple Mansion Golden Core Dao. Shehu had not even dared to capture real monks.

He remarked, "It seems that ordeal... truly frightened him!"

His golden eyes shone as he glanced over them. He found that they had not even been permitted to consume blood qi, and their cultivation was relatively pure. He stepped deeper inside, with Li Ximing following behind

Li Ximing mused, "There are over a hundred cultivators here, and even more mortals. We cannot take them back with us. Once we leave, I expect they will end up in the bellies of other cultivators."

Li Zhouwei replied, "Mercury Circulation Terrace has suffered a serious blow. These people's cultivation is untainted, so they could serve Daomian as outer disciples. Granduncle, weren't you also planning to use a spirit artifact to condense spirit water?"

Li Ximing nodded slightly and fell into thought. Without betraying any emotion, Li Zhouwei said, "Although that mystic can condense it on its own, we are not well versed in changes to the nature of materials. I think it would be best to leave such matters to a [Whole Pill] cultivator. We could ask for his advice and give him these people as compensation."

Li Ximing immediately nodded. "That is well thought out."

They searched the main hall and the cave dwelling but found nothing. The place was infuriatingly bare. Li Zhouwei swept his golden gaze around, then closed his eyes and connected to the Immortal Mirror. He soon understood,

The spirit root is in a cave dwelling beneath the sea. Shehu established Lesser Broadjade Mountain to guard it.

Before either could say more, a fierce wind rose outside. A streak of emerald light descended from the sky in the shape of a hawk, transforming upon landing into a middle-aged man. He had a broad forehead, sinister features, and a somewhat pale face. Glancing at the two, he looked surprised and even puzzled.

They dealt with Shehu so quickly? But there was no phenomenon. Could they have let him escape?

He brought his hands together. "The King of Wei certainly lives up to his reputation. Congratulations to you both, fellow Daoists!"

This was none other than Rogue Cultivator Yinxin! His divine abilities shone brilliantly, showing that he was quite capable. Li Ximing smiled faintly and nodded to him.

Yinxin said, "As for Shehu..."

Li Ximing replied casually, "We captured him for pill refinement. You needn't concern yourself with him, fellow Daoist."

The words were chilling enough. Combined with Li Ximing's casual expression and Li Zhouwei's silence, they carried a peculiar menace.

Rogue Cultivator Yinxin glanced at Li Ximing warily and said, "In that case, let us divide the spoils here and settle the matter."

His gaze seemed perfectly open, but Li Zhouwei, who had been silent all this time, said evenly, "There is no need to sound us out, fellow Daoist. Let us see the spirit root first."

A trace of disappointment flashed in Yinxin's eyes, though he showed no embarrassment. He smiled and replied, "Of course. After you!"
